cropharvest.task_sufficiency: SUFFICIENT FOR PLANNED SATELLITE CROP CLASSIFICATION

governance_rules.strict_isolation: PlantDoc, IP102, and CropHarvest datasets originate from disparate collection regimes and are never merged into a single training tensor or assumed to represent the same physical field.
governance_rules.vegetation_stress_distinction: CropHarvest ground truth is strictly crop classification. NDVI is pre-computed; NDMI canopy moisture requires unscaling B08/B11 or real-time Sentinel-2 L2A tile access.
governance_rules.unverified_results_prohibition: No accuracy or performance claims are made prior to actual execution.
